definitions.short: Kore , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H6981. Qore II. קוֺרֵא proper name, masculine Κωρηβ , Κωρη , etc.; Levites: 1 Chron Judg 9:19 ; Judg 26:1; ( קֹרֵא ); 2 2Chr 31:4 .
definitions.rootNote: or קֹרֵא ; (1 Chronicles 26:1), active participle of 7121 ; crier ;

occurrences.englishText: Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.
For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute Yahweh’s offerings and the most holy things.
